omittedResponsibilities: Scope is the original five architecture-neutral scalar specializations on the pinned native arm64 size_t64/default OpenMP0 target, using uint64 position vectors. Factory dispatch adapts native callable template instantiation syntax; it accepts only original scalar factors and has no fallback for unavailable SIMD values. SIMD SSE2/AVX2 specializations, OpenMP scheduling/concurrency, unsupported primary-template compile diagnostics, compile-time qualifiers/ABI, other native numeric vector widths, invalid negative/range/lifetime inputs, generic object/allocator behavior and complete SoA/Calc container/document/UI remain unverified. Number projections outside exact input/output representability are not certified. Full contextual upstream loop-unrolling QA remains source evidence, not a ported/executed suite.
preservedResponsibilities: Original none/lu4/lu8/lu16/lu32 specializations preserve the exact early return, unrolled lane ordering, bit-mask remainder and scalar tail logic; default_traits remains original lu16.

Only position values mutate; real shared backing arrays, sizes, block-pointer aliases, scalar payloads and reserved capacities are retained. Existing SoA owner and iterator storage mechanics are reused, with cached iterator nodes refreshed only by their original iterator operations.

Original unsigned64 position plus signed64 delta arithmetic is retained exactly through bigint; number syntax witnesses require exactly representable inputs and outputs. Large native start indices return before any number/index projection.
